resources.string: Studio mode records this book\'s speech ahead of time, from where you are, with the voice and speed you listen with, up to 6 hours at a time. Listening then plays the recording instead of waiting for the voice. It matters most for slow voices (downloaded Kokoro voices, acted Hindi); the built-in voice is fast enough to read live. It renders only while the phone is plugged in, unless you tap Start now.
Studio mode is preparing another book right now. It does one book at a time: stop that one on its card in the library first.

Kept inside ListenLock (not in your Files app) and played by itself when you listen to this book. Changing the voice, speed, pace or pronunciation fixes makes it stop matching; the next run makes it again. Updating the app or removing the book deletes it. Save as audio file puts a copy in Audiobooks on your phone.
